adjustments: Replaced the proposed units (src-kebabcase, src-isuppercase, types-types) with split and cases: the proposal ignored the api.json units the fixtures are filed under, sized each function by one overload line, and missed the call edges (camelCase->pascalCase, flatCase->kebabCase, case functions->splitByCase).
split owns isUppercase, splitByCase, upperFirst, lowerFirst: the leaf layer every converter calls; cases depends on it, so the cut is acyclic.
CaseOptions moved from types-types to cases: it is the options struct of four functions in cases and has nothing to call; types-types is dropped.
Private helper types in src/types.ts (Splitter, FirstOfString, ...) are not owned by any unit: they serve only the out-of-scope type-level helpers.
split is the tracer: it holds the riskiest semantics (UTF-16 split, full case mapping), so the harness and parity path are proven on them first.
